title: Raven’s destiny: chasing the NWA championship
summary: Raven arrives obsessed with taking Jeff Jarrett’s championship. His first major challenge fails, but the pursuit eventually delivers the title in King of the Mountain.

chapters.title: Jarrett survives Raven’s challenge
chapters.result: Jarrett defeats Raven to retain the NWA world championship.
chapters.context: Interference turns the title match into a chaotic battle, but Raven’s long-promised destiny remains out of reach.

chapters.title: Raven finally fulfills his destiny
chapters.result: Raven wins King of the Mountain to capture the NWA world championship.
chapters.context: Inserted into the match after Jarrett is removed in an on-screen arrest angle, Raven defeats a field including champion AJ Styles and finally claims the prize.
